full_judgment:
14. It appears from the judgment of the trial Court that the trial Court categorically stated in its judgment the case of the defendants. The plaintiffs claimed that S.A. Khatian was wrongly prepared and they prayed that S.A. record should be corrected. It also appears from the judgment of the trial Court that the plaintiffs adduced some evidences, that is, hokum nama, Exbt. A, rent receipts and the D.C.R. marked as Exbt. B and B1 and land tax payment slip, Exbt. 'C'. 

 18. Lower Courts' record was called for. On perusal of the plaint it appears that the plaintiff stated in his plaint the specification of the land. It is stated in the schedule of the plaint that District and P.S. Narsingdi, C.S. Mouza Dakshin Burair Hat, Khatian No.2 and S. A. Khatian No.3, Dag No.15 at present R.S. Khatian No.36 and Dag No.131 measuring the land ½  decimal. It is clear from this schedule that the land was clearly specified and the entire land measuring ½  decimal. So according to the provision of Order 7 rule 3 of the C.P.C. that the property should be identified and according to this description the property can be identify by the schedule. The plaintiffs did not claim any fraction, he claimed entire land of the plot that is ½  decimal of land.
